title: Customer-facing routing policy editor in Console: region/tier/fallback rules
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a customer-configurable policy editor inside Redwood Console that lets teams declare smart routing rules for API traffic. Policies should cover region selection, customer tier routing (e.g., premium vs standard), and automated fallback model variants when preferred capacity is unavailable. The editor must include live validation, a preview simulator (showing which model/region a sample request would route to), and an approval/rollout flow (draft -> staged -> active). Support expectations: per-route policies, per-environment scopes (hosted/dedicated/private), RBAC for who can edit/publish, and audit logging for all policy changes.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a new Policy Editor UI that allows creation of rules composed of matchers (route, header, geo, customer_tier) and actions (route_to_region, route_to_tier_backend, fallback_to_model_variant)
Editor validates rules client-side (syntax) and server-side (semantic checks: model availability, region compatibility, per-tenant limits) via /policies/validate API
Preview simulator executes the policy against a sample request and returns deterministic routing decision plus estimated latency and cost delta
Policies can be saved as Draft, staged to a Canary cohort, and promoted to Active with an audit trail entry for each transition
RBAC: only users with 'Policy Admin' role can publish; viewers can preview but not edit
Console displays warnings when a policy references model variants not compatible with target environment (e.g., private deployment missing model binary)
Telemetry emitted: policy_evaluations (per request sample), policy_validation_errors, publish_events; dashboards created in Console to show routing splits and fallback rates
E2E tests cover validation rules, preview simulator, and rollout gating mechanics
comments: 2026-02-27 - Initial scoping: met with runtime and infra teams. Runtime needs a /policies/validate and /policies/preview endpoint; infra flagged quota checks for Dedicated customers.
2026-03-03 - Design review: DES team proposed a builder-first UX (rule tiles + conditions). PM requested an escape hatch text-mode for power users. DES added inline examples and template library.

2026-03-05 - Engineering sync: ENG requested clear API contract for model variant compatibility (quantization/profile metadata). Follow-up action: ENG to provide model capability matrix by 2026-03-10.
2026-03-09 - Security review stubbed: policy changes must be immutably logged; KMS reference for private deployments noted. Security to run full review once API contract is stable.
2026-03-11 - Stakeholder feedback from Sales: need an examples gallery for common patterns (regional routing for latency, premium tier -> low-latency pool) to reduce support burden.

2026-03-12 - Decision: ship editor MVP limited to Hosted + Dedicated; Private deployment will allow editing but validation will surface 'unable to confirm' for air-gapped models. Post-MVP: full private validation via customer-provided inventory sync.
